title: 640,000 Tons Of Ghost Gear Haunt Oceans
hook: Ghost Gear Adds 640,000 Tons To Oceans Every Year
closing: Removing abandoned gear protects wildlife and cuts plastic that keeps fishing by itself.
question: Should retrieval be mandatory?

segments.say: Ghost fishing gear makes up 10% of ocean litter, but it keeps trapping animals after crews abandon it.
Lost ghost gear weighs 640,000 tons, turning working equipment into an enormous invisible waste stream.
Ghost gear entangles 100,000 animals, so this plastic threat keeps harming wildlife long after disposal.
